==English==
{{wp}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-free kick.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|American football|association football|Australian rules football|rugby|other ballgames}} a kick in which a player may kick the ball without interference from the opposition. Such a kick may be awarded for a [[foul]] by the opposition, or earned by a player such as by taking a [[mark]].<!-- a free kick can be earned in rubgy and in Australian rules football -->
#: {{ux|en|a '''free-kick''' specialist}}
# {{lb|en|Gaelic football}} The usual means of restarting play after a foul is committed, where the non-offending team restarts from where the foul was committed.
